teaser.en: A wild cousin of the coca plant, growing quietly in the coastal forest with leaves notched at the tip.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa porini wa mmea wa koka, unaoota kimya kimya katika msitu wa pwani, wenye majani yaliyo na kibonyeo kwenye ncha.

summary.en: *Chifumai* is a shrub or small tree of the coastal forest, from the same genus as the South American coca plant. Its leaves have a characteristic small notch at the tip.
summary.sw: *Chifumai* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa msitu wa pwani, wa jenasi ile ile ya mmea wa koka wa Amerika Kusini. Majani yake yana kibonyeo kidogo cha kipekee kwenye ncha.

about.en: *Erythroxylum emarginatum* is a shrub or small tree with smooth bark and alternate, oval leaves. The leaf tips are usually rounded and slightly notched, which gives the species its name *emarginatum*. The flowers are small and white, and the small oval fruits ripen red.
about.sw: *Erythroxylum emarginatum* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye gome laini na majani ya umbo la yai yanayopishana. Ncha za majani kwa kawaida ni za mviringo na zenye kibonyeo kidogo, na hilo ndilo linaloipa spishi hii jina lake *emarginatum*. Maua ni madogo na meupe, na matunda madogo ya umbo la yai huiva yakawa mekundu.

where.en: It grows in coastal and riverine forest and thicket from East Africa south to southern Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani na vya kando ya mito, kuanzia Afrika Mashariki kuelekea kusini hadi kusini mwa Afrika.

culture.en: Pakia lists *chifumai* as a tree name where the prefix *chi-* doesn't mean the plant is small.
culture.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *chifumai* kama jina la mti ambapo kiambishi *chi-* hakimaanishi kwamba mmea ni mdogo.

names.en: Pakia records *chifumai*, also written *chifumae*, and lists it among the names whose meaning cannot be analysed. No Swahili or English name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika *chifumai*, unaoandikwa pia *chifumae*, na anauorodhesha miongoni mwa majina ambayo maana yake haiwezi kuchambuliwa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.

reason.en: Another tree whose chi- is not diminutive
reason.sw: Mti mwingine ambao chi- yake si ya udogo

reason.en: Small tree of the coastal forest
reason.sw: Mti mdogo wa msitu wa pwani
